findings.title: One sloped segment discards valid foundations at the same elevation
findings.body: The code skips an entire elevation group when any member has an endpoint Z difference above the tolerance. Because grouping is based on each segment's average Z, an unrelated sloped CAD line whose average falls in the same bucket as valid horizontal foundation outlines causes all those outlines to be silently discarded. Reject or segregate non-horizontal segments before grouping instead of rejecting the whole group.

findings.title: New geometry behavior has no focused tests
findings.body: The added test project links PlanarFaceExtractor.cs but adds no test cases. Consequently, a test invocation can succeed while running zero tests, leaving intersection noding, shared-edge faces, elevation handling, rectangle extraction, and malformed or oversized CAD inputs unverified. This does not provide the risk-proportional validation required by the plan for the core auto-placement algorithm.

findings.title: Tests do not cover automatic foundation placement
findings.body: The suite only validates planar-face extraction and rectangle recognition. It never exercises the stated feature workflow from CAD geometry to created foundation instances, nor verifies placement coordinates, dimensions, rotation, type/level selection, duplicate handling, or failure behavior. Consequently, this test-only change can pass while AC-03 ('Auto place foundation from CAD') is entirely absent or broken.
